data.desc: ACCO Brands is the leader in branded consumer products that enable productivity, confidence and enjoyment while working, when learning and while playing. Our widely recognized brands include AT-A-GLANCE, Five Star, Kensington, Leitz, Mead, PowerA, Swingline, Tilibra and many others. More information about ACCO Brands Corporation (NYSE: ACCO) can be found at www.accobrands.com.
